caption.text: The perpendicular bisectors meet at the circumcentre $O$; drag $A$, $B$ or $C$.

meta.summary: The perpendicular bisectors of a triangle meet at its circumcentre $O$, the centre of the circle through $A$, $B$ and $C$.

mkp-math:construction@1.name: construction
mkp-math:construction@1.about: A ruler-and-compass construction over points A, B and C that you drag; every step follows.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.about: the steps, in order; args name points or earlier steps

inputs.name: free
inputs.about: how many free points: A and B, or A, B and C

value.expr: if(free == 3, put(put(put({}, "A", gpt(A)), "B", gpt(B)), "C", gpt(C)), put(put({}, "A", gpt(A)), "B", gpt(B)))

values.name: gstep
values.body: if(op == segment, {kind: seg, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == line, {kind: ln, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: 0}, if(op == circle, {kind: circ, a: o[0].a, b: o[1].a, r: gdist(o[0].a, o[1].a)}, if(op == midpoint, gpt(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5)), if(op == bisector, {kind: ln, a: gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), b: gadd(gscale(gadd(o[0].a, o[1].a), 0.5), gturn(gsub(o[1].a, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == perpendicular, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))), r: 0}, if(op == parallel, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a)), r: 0}, if(op == angle, {kind: ln, a: o[1].a, b: gadd(o[1].a, gadd(gunit(gsub(o[0].a, o[1].a)), gunit(gsub(o[2].a, o[1].a)))), r: 0}, if(op == meet, gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, o[1].b)), gpt(gmeet(o[0].a, o[0].b, o[1].a, gadd(o[1].a, gturn(gsub(o[0].b, o[0].a))))))))))))))
comment: one construction step from the objects so far

value.expr: fold(range(0, len(steps) - 1), start, (d, k) => put(d, nm(k), gstep(steps[k].op, map(steps[k].args, n => get(d, n, gpt((0, 0)))))))

label.expr: if(caption == "", "A construction over points you can drag", caption)

a.v: A construction over points you can drag

mkp-math:gpt#0.name: gpt
mkp-math:gpt#0.src: {kind: pt, a: p, b: p, r: 0}

mkp-math:gend#0.name: gend
mkp-math:gend#0.src: gadd(o.a, gscale(gsub(o.b, o.a), if(gt0(o, r) > gt1(o, r), 0, if(s < 0, gt0(o, r), gt1(o, r)))))

mkp-math:gt0#0.name: gt0
mkp-math:gt0#0.src: max(glo(o.a.x, o.b.x - o.a.x, r), glo(o.a.y, o.b.y - o.a.y, r))

mkp-math:gt1#0.name: gt1
mkp-math:gt1#0.src: min(ghi(o.a.x, o.b.x - o.a.x, r), ghi(o.a.y, o.b.y - o.a.y, r))

mkp-math:gmeet#0.name: gmeet
mkp-math:gmeet#0.src: gadd(a1, gscale(gsub(b1, a1), gcross(gsub(a2, a1), gsub(b2, a2))/gnz(gcross(gsub(b1, a1), gsub(b2, a2)))))
